title: Per Diem Kestrel Absorbs on Trade-In Lien Payoffs
content:
Part of the per diem a lienholder charges on a **Trade-In Agreements** payoff, between a quote's good-through date and the payoff send date, is absorbed by Kestrel: it is paid by Kestrel and not charged to the customer. The days Kestrel absorbs depend on how promptly the pickup inspection's deductions were posted, counted in calendar days from the pickup date to the posting date of the latest value deduction entry on the agreement's ledger, whatever the reason of that entry.

## Commitment

| Posting date of the latest value deduction entry | Days Kestrel absorbs |
|---|---|
| More than 2 days after the pickup date | Every day after the later of the good-through date and the pickup date, through the send date |
| At least 1 day and no more than 2 days after the pickup date | Every day after the later of the good-through date and the day 2 days after the pickup date, through the send date |
| Any other case (posted on the pickup date, or no value deduction entry on the ledger) | The days set by Kestrel's own payoff deadline: every day after the later of the good-through date and that deadline, through the send date, where the grade's late per-diem switch is on |

Kestrel's own payoff deadline is the grade's payoff send business days after the pickup date, counting Monday to Friday only and starting with the first weekday after the pickup date. No count of absorbed days falls below none.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

Pickup on Monday the 1st; quote good through the 1st; payoff sent on the 9th; grade payoff send business days of 3, so the deadline is Thursday the 4th; late per-diem switch on.

| Latest value deduction posted | Posting lag | Days Kestrel absorbs |
|---|---|---|
| The 5th | 4 days | 8 (the 2nd through the 9th) |
| The 3rd | 2 days | 6 (the 4th through the 9th) |
| The 2nd | 1 day | 6 (the 4th through the 9th) |
| The 1st | 0 days | 5 (the 5th through the 9th) |
| No value deduction entry | none | 5 (the 5th through the 9th) |

With the quote good through the 6th instead and a posting lag of 4 days, Kestrel absorbs the 7th through the 9th, which is 3 days.
